name: What is the typical cost range for professional beadboard installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for professional beadboard installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional beadboard installation can vary widely depending on factors like the type of material (solid wood, MDF, PVC), the square footage of the area, the complexity of the installation (e.g., intricate cuts, corners), and the chosen finish. Generally, costs include materials, labor, and any necessary surface preparation or trim work. For example, installing beadboard as wainscoting in a standard-sized room might range from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars, not including painting. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment in areas such as Meridian or Eagle to ensure accuracy based on your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation cost varies by material, square footage, and project complexity, typically ranging from hundreds to over a thousand dollars for a standard room, not including painting.
